text:
Hiroshima and Miyajima really do fit in one day, if you start at 7:30 and check one table before you book. Here's our 5-step checklist so you don't waste the island afternoon 👇

📌 Save this, then see the full timings 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day

1️⃣ OPEN THE TIDE TABLE FIRST

The Miyajima Tourist Association publishes one for the whole year. Below 100 cm you can walk to the torii, above 250 cm it floats. Choose the date, then the hotel.

2️⃣ BOOK THE EARLY MUSEUM SLOT

The Peace Memorial Museum opens at 7:30, and the first hour needs an online reservation. It's the calmest time to be there.

3️⃣ TAKE JR, NOT THE TRAM

About 25–30 minutes to Miyajimaguchi by JR versus about 70–75 by tram. On a one-day plan, that's an extra hour on the island.

4️⃣ CATCH A JR FERRY BETWEEN 9:10 AND 16:10

Those sailings take a route close to the Great Torii. Stand on the right-hand side facing forward.

5️⃣ KEEP ¥100 FOR THE ISLAND

Miyajima's visitor tax is included in normal tickets and IC taps; JR Pass holders buy it at the terminal.

🦌 And on Omotesando, eat your snacks inside the shop. The deer have learned where the food comes from.
